title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode4 Fulfilled Days

meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_leoneed_op2
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Festival Committee Member
rows.Line: Thank you all for casting your votes!

rows.Speaker: Festival Committee Member
rows.Line: For the school festival, Class B will be running a Japanese-style tea shop!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! The tea shop won!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: I can't wait to see this place all decorated and us in our uniforms.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, does that mean we're gonna design our own uniforms? Or should we rent them?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: It would be nice to take this opportunity to design some really cute ones ourselves. So, I might volunteer for the wardrobe team.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Designing them ourselves...!
Yeah, I wanna try too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Shiho!
How would you feel if I said I was gonna join the wardrobe team?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I don't see why you shouldn't.
I think it's good that you're so excited about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Aren't you excited about the school festival, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I am...
But until our show is over, I have to prioritize that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
You have been spending your lunches practicing really hard up on the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, Saki, aren't you also really busy with club activities and stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...
Y-Yeah, I am...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(But this is the school festival.
I want to do what I can for our class.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll try asking the club advisor about this during our practice after school.)
After school
Schoolyard
se_run_women_003_4

rows.Speaker: Club Captain
rows.Line:
Alright, two more laps, and I want you all to be louder!
Miya Girls!

rows.Speaker: Club Members
rows.Line: Let's go! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Miya Girls!

rows.Speaker: Club Members
rows.Line: Let's go! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Members
rows.Line: Huff...! Huff...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We're running at a harder pace than normal, which explains why the first-years look kind of exhausted.)

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Member
rows.Line: Huff...! Huff...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I know this is really hard...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But it's important to endure this, so I have to keep them motivated as their senior!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just a bit more! You guys got this...!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Member
rows.Line: Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know this is tough... When I first joined, I always felt totally drained after each run.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Member
rows.Line: You too...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But we'll get to take the court after this run!
So, keep pushing forward and moving those arms!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, this is the last lap!
Let's sprint to the finish together!

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Member
rows.Line: Okay...!
se_run_women_003_4

rows.Speaker: Club Captain
rows.Line:
Next is stroke practice!
Let's all get our rackets out!

rows.Speaker: Club Members
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year Club Member
rows.Line: Ready!
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_001

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Members
rows.Line: Nice volley!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ready!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hup...!
se_event_wl_2nd_lightsound_2025_002

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Members
rows.Line:
How did Tenma get to that ball...?!
That was amazing! Is she just that talented?

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Members
rows.Line: I dunno. I heard that Tenma's been in the soft tennis club since junior high, and she's been staying late to practice since back then.

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Members
rows.Line: Wait, since junior high?

rows.Speaker: First-Year Club Members
rows.Line: Yeah. She apparently wanted to do something about her getting sick all the time. She worked hard to build her stamina, and it all ended up a part of her daily routine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: One more ball!
The next day
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Yesterday's practice was so much fun.
And the advisor's surprise at the end was the cherry on top!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! We get to travel?!

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: Yes. I've been reaching out to a number of teachers I know, and talks are underway for our club to play against Reikan High School.

rows.Speaker: Club Captain
rows.Line: Reikan High School?! Aren't they always competing at nationals?! They even made it to the quarterfinals last year...

rows.Speaker: Advisor
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll be a wonderful learning opportunity, so I'll let you know once things are finalized.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I can't believe I might get to play against one of the best schools in the country! I must be dreaming! I hope they make it official soon.)
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki, morning...
Did you just have practice?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! We didn't plan on having a morning practice today, but everyone got so excited yesterday after the advisor told us how we might get to travel for a match!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Everyone? Something tells me that you suggested having practice in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, all I did was ask the advisor to use the court so that I could practice on my own.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, the others all came and joined me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Voluntarily? That's pretty amazing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honestly, I always thought the soft tennis club was more laid-back. Didn't you say that you went to practice one morning when you were a first-year and had the court all to yourself because nobody else was there?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right! But more and more people started showing up after that. Now, basically everyone's there each time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What if you inspired them to try just as hard as you, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I sure hope that's true!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can also learn from your example.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of which...!
What have you been doing lately, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You said that you've stopped visiting clubs.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'll need to wait a little bit longer before I'm ready to talk about that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Just a little bit longer?
Then, I might just ask you all about it when we hang out this weekend!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I promised that we'd hang out Saturday afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That reminds me, is it okay if we meet out in front of the school?! I have practice in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, but won't you want to head home for a bit first?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've got that covered♪ I'll make sure to take an extra set of clothes!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, going home seems like a big waste of time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because a day fiiinally came up when we're both free to hang out. So, Ichi, I want to spend as much time as I can with you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Saki, the bell's about to ring!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! Anyway, see you by the gate on Saturday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, see you then.
se_walk_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Wasn't that Hoshino from Class A? You've known each other since you were little, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we were talking about how we're gonna hang out on Saturday after I'm done with practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (My original hope was for all four of us to hang out, but I guess things just aren't gonna go back to how they were in junior high...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Back then, they all tried to spend as much time as they could with me to make sure that I was healthy.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I'm all better now, and they're busy pursuing the things they want in life.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It'd be nice if we could make up for all that by having fun together during the school festival...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, that reminds me. Are you free this Sunday?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: We were thinking about checking out some Japanese-style cafes to “research” their desserts.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna go!
Let's see... On Sunday, I have...
